page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.48xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 192 dedicated vCPUs paired with 512.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation ratio of 2.67 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Network performance is underpinned by a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth interface. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external block storage services for persistent data volumes. It contains zero dedicated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the massive core count allows extensive consolidation of compute-bound operations onto a single virtual node. The lack of built-in storage and accelerators targets resources directly into pure central processor capability and high-throughput networking. This architecture is suitable for high-performance computing (HPC), distributed compilation clusters, massive web serving infrastructures, batch processing, and large-scale data analytics pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.48xlarge is a dedicated compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. Configured with 192 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, the system delivers a balanced 2.67 GB of memory per core alongside a high-throughput 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no integrated local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external network-attached volumes for data retention. Delivering substantial core density and robust interconnect throughput without auxiliary accelerator hardware overhead, this virtual machine type is engineered for heavy parallel computing, large-scale CI/CD build farms, batch processing, and high-concurrency network services.
